amends: addendum 8, before any probe3/probe4 training (only a monitor test run in /tu/tests/add8_montest, stopped at iteration 700 by its stop file)
fact: The monitor test on probe4 shows the fork's scene extent of a small unit is 78.3 m (1.1 x max distance of its 44 training cameras from their mean), so the clone/split threshold is 0.78 m. In the cells it was 1.86 m (cell0), 2.28 m (cell2), 1.99 m (cell3). The runaway families' median max-axis scale is 1.1 m: cloned in the cells, but split in a small unit. The extent also scales the position learning rate (spatial_lr_scale) and the large-Gaussian prune (0.1 x extent). A small unit with its own extent therefore does not repeat the cells' densification regime.
